name: Model Editor
description: Design data models visually — drag entities, draw relations, and edit Prisma schemas on a canvas. Opens .prisma files and exports JSON Schema, SQL DDL, Mermaid and more.

creators.label: Prisma schema
TypeSpec API
Arazzo workflow
creators.template:
arazzo: 1.0.1
info:
  title: My workflow
  version: 1.0.0
# Point sourceDescriptions at the OpenAPI your .tsp emits; x-typespec-source links
# back to the contract so the editor can trace steps → endpoints → entities.
x-typespec-source: ./main.tsp
sourceDescriptions:
  - name: api
    url: ./openapi.yaml
    type: openapi
workflows:
  - workflowId: myWorkflow
    summary: Describe what this flow does.
    steps:
      - stepId: firstStep
        description: Call an operation from the source above.
        operationId: listItems
        successCriteria:
          - condition: $statusCode == 200
        outputs:
          result: $response.body
    outputs:
      result: $steps.firstStep.outputs.result

creators.label: AsyncAPI events
creators.template:
asyncapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: My events
  version: 1.0.0
# Message payloads that $ref a schema named like a .tsp model link to that entity;
# an x-operationId (or a channel address matching an endpoint route) links to an endpoint.
servers:
  live:
    host: example.com
    protocol: sse
channels:
  itemEvents:
    address: /items/events
    servers:
      - $ref: '#/servers/live'
    messages:
      itemChanged:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/ItemChanged'
operations:
  receiveItemChanged:
    action: receive
    channel:
      $ref: '#/channels/itemEvents'
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/itemEvents/messages/itemChanged'
components:
  messages:
    ItemChanged:
      summary: An item was created or updated.
      payload:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/Item'
  schemas:
    Item:
      type: object
